It was a haunting image... people without faces, in essence, it was the nightmare "The Cavalry without a Cavaliere..."

People in business suits, whom spied on, followed, and increasingly tormented Lawrence's privacy. But something happened to Lawrence... in a dream, he sees his little brother and mother eating as if in a different world, alternate reality... where no pain exists... "Just this quiet moment you can revisit whenever you wish..." 

This was enough to keep Lawrence from falling apart... "You have answered my prayers LORD... though my Rationale will always question if it really is you, or all in my troubled head..."
